content.name: Lock
entries: A key is provided with the lock. Without the key, a creature proficient with {@item thieves' tools|srd51} can pick this lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. Your DM may decide that better locks are available for higher prices.

content.name: Lock
entries: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use {@item Thieves' Tools|SRD52} to pick this Lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check.
